   166	    func search(_ query: String) -> [NoteSearchResult] {
   167	        let trimmedQuery = query.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
   168	        if trimmedQuery.isEmpty {
   169	            return Array(allNotes.prefix(20).map(\.result))
   170	        }
   171	
   172	        let parsedQuery = Self.parseQuery(trimmedQuery)
   173	        let expandedTokens = Set(Self.expandQueryTokens(parsedQuery.queryTokens))
   174	
   175	        let ranked: [(NoteSearchResult, Int)] = allNotes
   176	            .compactMap { indexed -> (NoteSearchResult, Int)? in
   177	                guard matchesFilters(indexed, query: parsedQuery) else { return nil }
   178	                let rank = score(
   179	                    indexed,
   180	                    parsedQuery: parsedQuery,
   181	                    queryTokens: expandedTokens
   182	                )
   183	                guard rank > 0 else { return nil }
   184	                let preview = Self.preview(
   185	                    from: indexed,
   186	                    normalizedQuery: parsedQuery.normalizedQuery,
   187	                    queryTokens: expandedTokens
   188	                )
   189	                let result = NoteSearchResult(
   190	                    id: indexed.result.id,
   191	                    title: indexed.result.title,
   192	                    relativePath: indexed.result.relativePath,
   193	                    url: indexed.result.url,
   194	                    preview: preview,
   195	                    score: rank
   196	                )
   197	                return (result, rank)
   198	            }
   199	
   200	        return ranked
   201	            .sorted { first, second in
   202	                if first.1 == second.1 {
   203	                    return first.0.title.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(second.0.title) == .orderedAscending
   204	                }
   205	                return first.1 > second.1
   206	            }
   207	            .map { $0.0 }
   208	    }

   225	    private func updateDocumentFrequency(previous: IndexedNote, updated: IndexedNote) {
   226	        let previousTokens = uniqueTokens(for: previous)
   227	        let updatedTokens = uniqueTokens(for: updated)
   228	        let removedTokens = previousTokens.subtracting(updatedTokens)
   229	        let addedTokens = updatedTokens.subtracting(previousTokens)
   230	
   231	        for token in removedTokens {
   232	            let currentCount = documentFrequency[token] ?? 0
   233	            if currentCount <= 1 {
   234	                documentFrequency.removeValue(forKey: token)
   235	            } else {
   236	                documentFrequency[token] = currentCount - 1
   237	            }
   238	        }
   239	
   240	        for token in addedTokens {
   241	            documentFrequency[token, default: 0] += 1
   242	        }
   243	    }

   249	    private func score(
   250	        _ indexed: IndexedNote,
   251	        parsedQuery: ParsedQuery,
   252	        queryTokens: Set<String>
   253	    ) -> Int {
   254	        let query = parsedQuery.displayQuery
   255	        let normalizedQuery = parsedQuery.normalizedQuery
   256	        let normalizedPhrases = parsedQuery.normalizedPhrases
   257	        let hasSearchTerms = parsedQuery.hasSearchTerms
   258	        var total = recencyBoost(for: indexed.modifiedAt)
   259	        var relevanceSignals = 0
   260	        let lowerQuery = query.lowercased()
   261	
   262	        if !normalizedQuery.isEmpty && indexed.normalizedTitle == normalizedQuery {
   263	            total += Self.ScoreWeights.exactTitleMatch
   264	            relevanceSignals += 1
   265	        } else if !normalizedQuery.isEmpty && indexed.normalizedTitle.contains(normalizedQuery) {
   266	            total += Self.ScoreWeights.partialTitleMatch
   267	            relevanceSignals += 1
   268	        }
   269	
   270	        if !normalizedQuery.isEmpty && indexed.normalizedContent.contains(normalizedQuery) {
   271	            total += Self.ScoreWeights.exactContentMatch
   272	            relevanceSignals += 1
   273	        }
   274	
   275	        if !lowerQuery.isEmpty, let titleFuzzy = indexed.result.title.fuzzyScore(lowerQuery) {
   276	            total += titleFuzzy * Self.ScoreWeights.titleFuzzyMultiplier
   277	            relevanceSignals += 1
   278	        }
   279	
   280	        for phrase in normalizedPhrases where !phrase.isEmpty {
   281	            if indexed.normalizedTitle.contains(phrase) {
   282	                total += Self.ScoreWeights.titlePhraseMatch
   283	                relevanceSignals += 1
   284	            }
   285	            if indexed.normalizedContent.contains(phrase) {
   286	                total += Self.ScoreWeights.contentPhraseMatch
   287	                relevanceSignals += 1
   288	            }
   289	        }
   290	
   291	        for token in queryTokens {
   292	            let inverseDocumentWeight = inverseDocumentFrequency(for: token)
   293	            let tokenWeight = max(inverseDocumentWeight, 1)
   294	            if indexed.titleTokens.contains(token) {
   295	                total += Self.ScoreWeights.titleTokenMatch * tokenWeight
   296	                relevanceSignals += 1
   297	            } else if indexed.titleTokens.contains(where: { $0.hasPrefix(token) || token.hasPrefix($0) }) {
   298	                total += Self.ScoreWeights.titlePrefixTokenMatch * tokenWeight
   299	                relevanceSignals += 1
   300	            }
   301	
   302	            let frequency = indexed.contentTokenCounts[token] ?? 0
   303	            if frequency > 0 {
   304	                total += min(frequency, Self.ScoreWeights.maxContentFrequencyCount)
   305	                    * Self.ScoreWeights.contentTokenMatch
   306	                    * tokenWeight
   307	                relevanceSignals += 1
   308	            }
   309	        }
   310	
   311	        let matchedTokenCount = queryTokens.filter { token in
   312	            indexed.titleTokens.contains(token) || indexed.contentTokenCounts[token] != nil
   313	        }.count
   314	
   315	        if matchedTokenCount == queryTokens.count && !queryTokens.isEmpty {
   316	            total += Self.ScoreWeights.allTokensMatchBonus
   317	        } else if matchedTokenCount > 0 {
   318	            total += matchedTokenCount * Self.ScoreWeights.partialTokenMatchBonus
   319	        }
   320	
   321	        if !hasSearchTerms {
   322	            total += Self.ScoreWeights.filterOnlyQueryBonus
   323	        }
   324	
   325	        if hasSearchTerms && relevanceSignals == 0 {
   326	            return 0
   327	        }
   328	
   329	        return total
   330	    }

   332	    private func matchesFilters(_ indexed: IndexedNote, query: ParsedQuery) -> Bool {
   333	        if !query.requiredTags.isEmpty {
   334	            for filterTag in query.requiredTags where !containsTag(filterTag, in: indexed.tags) {
   335	                return false
   336	            }
   337	        }
   338	
   339	        if !query.requiredPeople.isEmpty {
   340	            for filterPerson in query.requiredPeople where !containsPerson(filterPerson, in: indexed.mentions) {
   341	                return false
   342	            }
   343	        }
   344	
   345	        if !query.requiredPaths.isEmpty {
   346	            let path = indexed.result.relativePath.lowercased()
   347	            for requiredPath in query.requiredPaths where !path.contains(requiredPath) {
   348	                return false
   349	            }
   350	        }
   351	
   352	        if !query.normalizedPhrases.isEmpty {
   353	            for phrase in query.normalizedPhrases {
   354	                let inTitle = indexed.normalizedTitle.contains(phrase)
   355	                let inContent = indexed.normalizedContent.contains(phrase)
   356	                if !inTitle && !inContent {
   357	                    return false
   358	                }
   359	            }
   360	        }
   361	
   362	        return true
   363	    }

   373	    private func recencyBoost(for modifiedAt: Date) -> Int {
   374	        let daysAgo = Date().timeIntervalSince(modifiedAt) / 86_400
   375	        switch daysAgo {
   376	        case ..<1:
   377	            return Self.RecencyWeights.lastDay
   378	        case ..<7:
   379	            return Self.RecencyWeights.lastWeek
   380	        case ..<30:

   382	        default:
   383	            return 0
   384	        }

   387	    private func inverseDocumentFrequency(for token: String) -> Int {
   388	        let documents = max(allNotes.count, 1)
   389	        let occurrences = max(documentFrequency[token] ?? 0, 1)
   390	        let ratio = Double(documents) / Double(occurrences)
   391	        switch ratio {
   392	        case ..<1.5:
   393	            return 1
   394	        case ..<3.0:
   395	            return 2
   396	        case ..<6.0:
   397	            return 3
   398	        default:
   399	            return 4
   400	        }
   401	    }

   551	    private static func parseQuery(_ query: String) -> ParsedQuery {
   552	        let (fragments, phrases) = splitFragments(query)
   553	        var rawTerms: [String] = []
   554	        var requiredTags: Set<String> = []
   555	        var requiredPeople: Set<String> = []
   556	        var requiredPaths: [String] = []
   557	
   558	        for fragment in fragments {
   559	            if let pathFilter = parseFilter(fragment, key: "path")
   560	                ?? parseFilter(fragment, key: "in") {
   561	                requiredPaths.append(pathFilter.lowercased())
   562	                continue
   563	            }
   564	
   565	            if let tagFilter = parseFilter(fragment, key: "tag") {
   566	                requiredTags.insert(tagFilter)
   567	                continue
   568	            }
   569	            if let personFilter = parseFilter(fragment, key: "person")
   570	                ?? parseFilter(fragment, key: "people")
   571	                ?? parseFilter(fragment, key: "mention") {
   572	                requiredPeople.insert(personFilter)
   573	                continue
   574	            }
   575	
   576	            if fragment.hasPrefix("#"), let tagFilter = normalizeTag(fragment) {
   577	                requiredTags.insert(tagFilter)
   578	                continue
   579	            }
   580	            if fragment.hasPrefix("@"), let personFilter = normalizePerson(fragment) {
   581	                requiredPeople.insert(personFilter)
   582	                continue
   583	            }
   584	
   585	            rawTerms.append(fragment)
   586	        }
   587	
   588	        let normalizedPhrases = phrases.map(normalizeText).filter { !$0.isEmpty }
   589	        let phraseTokens = phrases.flatMap(tokens(from:))
   590	        let termTokens = rawTerms.flatMap(tokens(from:)) + phraseTokens
   591	        let displayQuery = (rawTerms + phrases).joined(separator: " ").trimmingCharacters(
   592	            in: .whitespacesAndNewlines
   593	        )
   594	        let normalizedQuery = normalizeText(displayQuery)
   595	
   596	        return ParsedQuery(
   597	            displayQuery: displayQuery,
   598	            normalizedQuery: normalizedQuery,
   599	            queryTokens: termTokens,
   600	            normalizedPhrases: normalizedPhrases,
   601	            requiredTags: requiredTags,
   602	            requiredPeople: requiredPeople,
   603	            requiredPaths: requiredPaths
   604	        )
   605	    }

   607	    private static func splitFragments(_ query: String) -> ([String], [String]) {
   608	        var fragments: [String] = []
   609	        var phrases: [String] = []
   610	        var current = ""
   611	        var inQuote = false
   612	
   613	        for character in query {
   614	            if character == "\"" {
   615	                if inQuote {
   616	                    let phrase = current.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
   617	                    if !phrase.isEmpty {
   618	                        phrases.append(phrase)
   619	                    }
   620	                    current = ""
   621	                } else if !current.isEmpty {
   622	                    fragments.append(contentsOf: splitWords(current))
   623	                    current = ""
   624	                }
   625	                inQuote.toggle()
   626	                continue
   627	            }
   628	            current.append(character)
   629	        }
   630	
   631	        if !current.isEmpty {
   632	            fragments.append(contentsOf: splitWords(current))
   633	        }
   634	
   635	        return (fragments, phrases)
   636	    }

   643	    }

   645	    private static func parseFilter(_ fragment: String, key: String) -> String? {
   646	        let parts = fragment.split(separator: ":", maxSplits: 1).map(String.init)
   647	        guard parts.count == 2,
   648	              parts[0].lowercased() == key.lowercased() else { return nil }
   649	        let value = parts[1].trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
   650	        guard !value.isEmpty else { return nil }
   651	        if key == "path" || key == "in" {
   652	            return value.lowercased()
   653	        }
   654	        if key == "tag" {
   655	            return normalizeTag(value)
   656	        }
   657	        return normalizePerson(value)
   658	    }

   660	    private static func normalizeTag(_ rawTag: String) -> String? {
   661	        let cleaned = rawTag.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
   662	            .trimmingCharacters(in: CharacterSet(charactersIn: "#"))
   663	            .lowercased()
   664	        guard cleaned.count >= 2 else { return nil }
   665	        let allowed = cleaned.replacingOccurrences(
   666	            of: "[^a-z0-9_-]",
   667	            with: "",
   668	            options: .regularExpression
   669	        )
   670	        guard !allowed.isEmpty else { return nil }
   671	        return allowed
   672	    }

   674	    private static func normalizePerson(_ rawPerson: String) -> String? {
   675	        let cleaned = rawPerson.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
   676	            .trimmingCharacters(in: CharacterSet(charactersIn: "@"))
   677	            .lowercased()
   678	        guard cleaned.count >= 2 else { return nil }
   679	        let collapsed = cleaned.replacingOccurrences(
   680	            of: "\\s+",
   681	            with: " ",
   682	            options: .regularExpression
   683	        )
   684	        guard !collapsed.isEmpty else { return nil }
   685	        return collapsed
   686	    }

   688	    private static func extractTags(from content: String) -> Set<String> {

   690	        let searchRange = NSRange(content.startIndex..<content.endIndex, in: content)
   691	        let matches = regex.matches(in: content, range: searchRange)
   692	        var tags: Set<String> = []
